cases.purpose: An explicitly empty fixture path must fail opening the fixture rather than read the live kernel ring; -c must never call syslog when the hook is present.
cases.oracle: Empty pathname fails; seccomp kills any syslog call. Failure must be status 1, with no records printed.
cases.candidate_script:
[[ $(type -t dmesg) == builtin ]] || exit 125
BASHDMESG_DEV_KMSG_FILE= PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-seccomp.py --kill syslog -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c '[[ $(type -t dmesg) == builtin ]] || exit 125; dmesg -c -t' >empty-hook.out 2>empty-hook.err
rc=$?
[[ $rc == 1 && ! -s empty-hook.out ]] || exit 1
/usr/bin/grep -q 'read kernel buffer failed:' empty-hook.err || exit 1
printf 'PASS\n'
